{{Leo}}
Leo 20 is the 244th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 20th day of Leo, and it is a Saturday. It corresponds to ISO week 35, weekday 6.

Its informal Japanese name is 9宮20日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 244|Chapter 244]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152264}}.
